events.title: Proposed ruling: no_action (model confidence 0.88)
events.body:
The rider cancelled this RydeX booking, so the fee can only arise through NS-0's rider branch [F2][NS-0]. The rider cancelled 3 min 5 s (185 s) after matching, i.e. outside the 3-minute grace period, so the $6.61 cancellation fee is chargeable [F2][NS-4]. The record shows a cancellation fee of $6.61 actually charged, which matches the published fee and is not an unpublished add-on [F5][FARE-1].

The rider's stated reason — the driver was still far away — does not create a ground for free cancellation. Ryde has published no rule entitling a rider to cancel free of charge because the driver is late (NS-8 is informational only and cannot be applied), so the driver's distance at the moment of cancellation does not defeat the fee [F1][F8][NS-4]. At most the rider's remedy is the human fee-waiver route under NS-7, not a refund by this ruling [F5][NS-7].

The fact that the driver never arrived and never tapped "I'm Here" is relevant to the driver-side no-show branch (NS-1/NS-2), which only governs cases where the driver cancels claiming the rider no-showed; here the rider cancelled, so those conditions are not the operative test and their failure does not shift the fee [F3][F4][NS-1]. Likewise the traffic and weather facts are not needed to excuse any route change in a completed trip — there is no off-route segment fact in this case, so RD-1 to RD-4 are not engaged [F11][F12][F13][RD-1].

Safety screen: the chat contains only the rider asking how long the driver would be and the driver replying "About 5 min, traffic"; the driver's statement only says he was on his way. No threat, intimidation, harassment, sexual remark or dangerous-driving allegation appears anywhere in the chat, statement or complaint, so no escalation on safety grounds [F7][F8][F10][SAFE-1][SAFE-2].

Because no basis for a refund exists and no safety or evidence gap requires a human, the correct outcome is no_action with no amount [F2][F5][NS-4].

Nothing in the trip chat or your statement raised a safety concern, so no account action is being taken against you. No further steps are needed from you.
